operationName: Ecuador Internal Armed Conflict / Estado de Excepción
heroHeadline: Noboa Declares 60-Day State of Emergency Across 10 Provinces as Homicides Surge
heroSubtitle: On June 17, 2026, President Daniel Noboa declared a 60-day state of emergency across 10 provinces, suspending home inviolability, after 879 homicides were recorded between May 1 and June 12. Ecuador has posted Latin America's highest homicide rate for three consecutive years, with roughly 132,000 people internally displaced. US-assisted land operations on Ecuadorian soil began March 3, 2026, marking an expansion of direct American security cooperation. Gang control over prisons, port-based cocaine trafficking through Guayaquil and Esmeraldas, and clashes between Los Choneros- and Los Lobos-aligned factions remain central drivers of the crisis.
